column1: # UADx Brigade Chorus (aufx U3BO UADx, Boss CE-1 model, PACE: black-box only). Wet delay trajectory from an impulse train (one -6 dBFS click every 10 ms, 48 kHz, 6 s). Reported latency 31 samples (0.646 ms) is subtracted.

# render:  $RE_STATE/bin/auhost render aufx U3BO UADx clicks480.wav br.wav --warmup 2 --set 54=<0 Classic|1 Dual> --set 52=<0 Chorus|1 Vibrato> --set 49=<chorus intensity 0..1> --set 50=<vib depth> --set 51=<vib rate>
# analyse: python3 $T/cx.py trk br.wav --period 480 --ch <ch> --mind 1.2 --lat 0.646 --short ; python3 $T/cx.py lr br.wav --period 480 --mind 1.2 --lat 0.646
# Classic mode: L carries only the dry tap, R only the wet tap (see brigade_taps.txt). Dual mode: both channels carry dry + wet.
